title: Cmi5Registration
description: cmi5 course assignment, learner and native evidence relationship.

id.description: Immutable identity allocated once by the interoperability owner.

enrollment_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

activity_version_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

package_version_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

external_registration_uuid.description: cmi5 registration identity supplied to AU launches.

state.description: Native registration lifecycle derived under policy.

revision.description: Monotonic aggregate revision used for compare-and-swap.

institution_id.description: Institution that owns this registration and learning record profile.
institution_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve in the exact owning Institution.

enrollment_release_id.description: Effective assignment release pinned at registration.
enrollment_release_id.x-reference-scope: Release belongs to this exact Enrollment.

placement_id.description: Exact occurrence of the packaged activity in the assigned release.
placement_id.x-reference-scope: Placement belongs to this exact release and resolves to the pinned ActivityVersion.

course_structure_digest.description: Digest of immutable approved cmi5 course structure.

satisfaction_policy_revision.description: Immutable MoveOn and evidence projection policy revision.

x-invariants: AU evidence is bound to this registration and exact course revision.
Satisfied evidence derives from declared MoveOn and valid AU outcomes.
One enrollment may launch the same ActivityVersion in different placements without sharing registration, AU evidence, or attempt ordinals.
